validated_boundaries: C3-HARNESS owns session creation, process, transport, claim, and lifecycle while O/target workers have no control access.
SESSION_ID, SESSION_OPEN hash, consecutive sequence, predecessor result, and locked-policy transition join separately signed calls.
The locked method policy alone supplies transition authority.
Dynamic plan, permission, action, and fallback data require a new proposal and independent signed O decision.
Normal close requires O's signed last-result/phase-bound close decision; only the controller drains, exits, reaps, and releases.
Failure cleanup is controller-owned, bounded, records abort, invents no hardware cleanup call, and claims no clean successful return.
Closed or aborted sessions cannot accept calls, restart under the same ID, resume, or be reused.
